title: Nickname Hook and the head-shaving prank with Pansy Lane
summary: Loyacano says he was called Hook; Crawford mentions Daniel Mello's story of him and Pansy Lane, and Loyacano describes getting their heads shaved with a razor for fun.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Yeah, they used to call me Hook. On account of the noise.
Daniel Mello was telling about you and Pansy Lane kidding each other.
Yeah, we got all our hair shaved off one time.
We got a shave with a razor. Got their hair all cut off and then the head shaved with a razor.
That's all, just for the kicks. You could pull a handkerchief over our head with a silk handkerchief without it sticking.
